content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Conventional platforms like Teachable and Gumroad offer rented storefronts with payment processing. They lock your data, charge monthly fees, and collapse when Stripe or PayPal withdraw. Sovereign commerce stacks invert this. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront for free. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. You own the infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform risk. Full data portability. The tradeoff: you deploy and maintain the stack. The reward: permanent ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on financial risk, not creator merit. Platforms built on these processors inherit their restrictions. Teachable, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy are unavailable in Nigeria, Pakistan, and Zimbabwe. PayPal suspends accounts in these regions for 180 days without recourse. Sovereign stacks bypass this by processing payments on-chain via NOWPayments. 300+ cryptocurrencies. 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer account required. The network (BSC, Solana, TRON) handles transactions for under $0.10. Infrastructure sovereignty decouples your commerce from any single processor’s political or financial decisions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Teachable charges 5% plus Stripe’s 2.9% + $0.30. Gumroad takes 8.5% plus payment fees. PayPal holds funds for 180 days in restricted regions. Sovereign stacks charge a 0.5% fee via NOWPayments. Transaction costs on BSC, Solana, or TRON are under $0.10. Funds settle directly to your wallet. No platform cuts. No holding periods. The real cost is deployment time. COREMERCH’s Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours. Edge Commerce Stack ($197) adds SPF/DKIM/DMARC and end-to-end testing. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates for self-deployment. Tradeoff: initial setup time. Reward: lifetime ownership with no recurring fees.
Stripe excludes 149 countries. Sovereign infrastructure is not a workaround—it’s base-layer architecture.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Teachable and Gumroad own your customer data. They control your storefront. They can suspend your account. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. GitHub or Cloudflare host your storefront. Supabase or Google Sheets store your orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver your files. NOWPayments automates payment verification via webhooks. The moment payment confirms on-chain, the system delivers the product. No manual intervention. No platform dependency. The tradeoff: you manage your infrastructure. The reward: no one can suspend your business or hold your funds.

If you’re in a Stripe-excluded country, sovereign infrastructure is not optional—it’s your only permanent solution. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Choose based on your technical skill, product volume, and need for email deliverability.
